title: Nvidia introduces new GPU library to advance AI integration in semiconductor design and fabs
key_facts: Nvidia announced cuPotential, a new library in its CUDA-X collection, meant to help build AI agents that simulate how atoms and molecules interact.
In early-access testing it reportedly sped up already GPU-optimised workflows by an additional 2 to 3 times.
Nvidia said Siemens, Applied Materials, Foxconn and Synopsys are using its libraries for AI-defined fabs and chip design.
Lam Research expects Nvidia's NanoVDB library to speed up some wafer-etch modelling by up to 30 times.
Several CUDA-X libraries are open source.
The outlet's analyst adds that this could deepen dependence on a US supplier; that is the author's view.
